rv.q: Mostly, though, Murdoch: The Final Interview is made up of toothless satirical gestures and bits of dime-store psychologizing.
We don't know what to grab onto. And we leave not knowing Murdoch much better than we did when we came in.
This is a hatchet job with a very dull blade.

cn.t: Critics find this one-man takedown of Rupert Murdoch heavy-handed and shallow, with reviewers noting its obvious antipathy toward its subject fails to offer meaningful insight or dramatic coherence despite attention-grabbing marketing.
